$comment: The course notice boards (docs/specs/COURSE-BOARDS.md, docs/content-data.md): the header and pins, and which ## sections aren't topics. Which chapter an island's board shows is the island's chapter in course.json; where it stands is the game's (src/world/islands/course-boards.ts). The topics themselves come from lock.json, so the weekly course sync keeps them current. Read from the active course pack by src/content/course-boards.ts; checked by src/content/content.test.ts and `npm run content:check`. In the text, {num} is the chapter's number ("01") and {title} its title in the course.
